phases.objective: Prove one synthetic Tenant storage request from mounted HTTP entrypoint through Context Kernel authority, immutable plan and fixed execution contracts to durable journal, reconciliation guards, and Tenant-safe readback.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact synthetic operation returns Tenant-safe reconciled readback while immutable plan, append-only journal, retry, SHA, and cross-Tenant guards remain enforced.
steps: Execute the mounted Tenant HTTP runtime journey through Context Kernel and effective-authority dynamic evidence.
Bind the request to the exact operation and expected SHA while rejecting request-side authority injection and cross-Tenant context.
Consume one manual enablement only after all checks and dispatch the fixed synthetic worker path without free-form shell input.
Require the durable control-plane contract to preserve immutable plans, append-only approvals, CAS lease generations, and restart-safe journal ordering.
Require single-use plan consumption and unknown-outcome retry protection.
Return only Tenant-safe evidence with provider dispatch, live mutation, Production readiness, and secrets disabled.
assertions: The mounted route reports Context Kernel and effective-authority evidence success.
Expected-SHA mismatch, authority injection, Admin use, and cross-Tenant access fail before mutation consumption.
Immutable plan, append-only approvals, CAS leases, restart-safe journal, single-use plan, and unknown-outcome retry guards all pass.
The journey is synthetic-only and cannot call a provider, deploy, apply SQL, or become Production-ready.
No secret or raw credential field is emitted.

phases.objective: Extend the journey with cancellation, approval revocation, bounded retry, and operator-visible transitions.
Extend the journey with fault injection, worker restart recovery, and checkpoint restoration.
Run the journey against one separately authorized non-production Tenant target.
This bounded change supplies synthetic MVP evidence only and grants no Production authority.
